mission: MISSION 3: Full design overhaul of admin + tenant panels (59 pages) — premium fintech-SaaS aesthetic (Finexy reference), NEW color system, Framer Motion, glassy/3D accents, mobile-optimized app-like, full-day work comfort, zero-lag.
awaiting_gate_note: GATE 2 PASSED 2026-06-14. ALL 59 pages restyled to Finexy, SHIPPED + live (200). HARDEN gauntlet clean (code SHIP / QA PASS / security SAFE-TO-SHIP, presentation-only confirmed); 2 minor findings fixed+deployed (sticky table header, gitignore pw-*). Founder GATE 2 answers: (1) add mock data + verify everything; (2) restore Dashboard Conversations+ActiveInstances KPIs. DONE: restored both admin Dashboard KPIs (6-up strip). Built+ran apps/server/scripts/seed-demo.ts (idempotent, ~40 tables, 5 demo tenants incl rich Demo Tenant; deletes scoped to demo ids/markers; founder user+plans untouched). Authenticated visual QA sweep (browse, demo super-admin owner@demo.test) found React #130 crashes on /team + /complaints + dashboard ComplaintsWidget -> root cause invalid seed enums (role staff->agent, complaint category product->product_issue) + added defensive roleConfig/categoryIcons fallbacks so no single bad row can white-screen a page. Re-swept all 50 routes (26 tenant + 24 admin): ZERO crashes. Screenshots desktop+mobile confirm polished Finexy UI, populated data, app-like mobile (bottom tab bar). Commits: 330b74e batch9, 2d3c4e5 table/gitignore, 739460f KPIs+seed, 90a6379 crash fixes. NOTE: demo data + demo super-admin grant (system_roles for owner@demo.test) live in prod DB by founder request; remove before real-tenant launch if desired (seed deletes are demo-scoped). Deferred non-blocking data gaps remain: split WA/FB unread, real avg-response-time, payment-method breakdown, AdminCampaignDetail delivery analytics.
